summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing daily open-market repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares under a buyback announced July 21, 2026. Between September 21 and 25, 2026, Wise repurchased 1,494,000 shares — 644,479 on Nasdaq and 849,521 across the London Stock Exchange and CHIX — through Goldman Sachs International, at volume-weighted averages of roughly GBP 8.56–8.71 and USD 11.28–11.61. Shares are held in treasury. The program authorizes up to GBP 405 million (about USD 540 million). Watch execution pace, treasury share accretion, and any upsize or early termination.
